title: Expired Papers
description: A driver's boarding papers (access token) have expired mid-shift. Call a protected route with an expired or malformed token and confirm SwiftCargo rejects it cleanly instead of leaking a stack trace.
successCondition: GET /api/auth/me with an expired or invalid Authorization header returns 401 with body { error: { code: "TOKEN_EXPIRED" | "UNAUTHORIZED", message } }.
hints: You can mint an already-expired token by setting ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS very low before logging in, or simply tamper with a valid token's signature.
Look at core/errors.ts in the api app for the exact error shape to assert against.
